package mime

import (
	"io"
	stdmime "mime"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/conf"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/log"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/resources"
	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
)

type configuration struct {
	Types    map[string]string `yaml:"types"`
	Lossless []string          `yaml:"lossless"`
}

var LosslessFormats []string

func init() {
	conf.AddHook(loadConfiguration)
}

func loadConfiguration() {
	file, err := resources.FS().Open("mime_types.yaml")
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal("Could not open MIME types configuration", err)
	}
	defer file.Close()

	data, err := io.ReadAll(file)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal("Could not read MIME types configuration", err)
	}

	var config configuration
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &config); err != nil {
		log.Fatal("Could not parse MIME types configuration", err)
	}

	for extension, contentType := range config.Types {
		if err := stdmime.AddExtensionType(extension, contentType); err != nil {
			log.Fatal("Could not register MIME type", "extension", extension, "type", contentType, err)
		}
	}

	LosslessFormats = make([]string, 0, len(config.Lossless))
	for _, extension := range config.Lossless {
		LosslessFormats = append(LosslessFormats, strings.TrimPrefix(extension, "."))
	}
	sort.Strings(LosslessFormats)

	// Some Windows configurations assign JS the text/plain MIME type.
	_ = stdmime.AddExtensionType(".js", "text/javascript")
	_ = stdmime.AddExtensionType(".css", "text/css")
}
package model

import (
	stdmime "mime"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	_ "github.com/navidrome/navidrome/mime"
)

var excludeAudioType = []string{
	"audio/x-mpegurl",
	"audio/x-scpls",
}

func IsAudioFile(filePath string) bool {
	extension := filepath.Ext(filePath)
	mimeType := stdmime.TypeByExtension(extension)
	return !slices.Contains(excludeAudioType, mimeType) && strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "audio/")
}

func IsImageFile(filePath string) bool {
	extension := filepath.Ext(filePath)
	return strings.HasPrefix(stdmime.TypeByExtension(extension), "image/")
}

func IsValidPlaylist(filePath string) bool {
	extension := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(filePath))
	return extension == ".m3u" || extension == ".m3u8" || extension == ".nsp"
}
